name: D9b episode-held-out TRAIN comparison
purpose: test whether the shared-amplitude direct response model generalizes beyond its training episodes and improves on D2 learned futures
scope: TRAIN partition only; DEV and TEST remain closed

data.split_rule: same deterministic first-12-percent episode split used by D2 and D6

model.architecture: unchanged D9b raw temporal pair encoder, six-level context, shared ReLU group amplitude and per-level softplus shapes
model.amplitude_target: RMS magnitude over all six levels and all 41 continuous log1p response values
model.shape_target: per-level continuous target divided by shared amplitude for nonzero groups

optimization.sampling: deterministic uniform group sampling without replacement within each step; no class balancing
optimization.loss: shared group amplitude MSE plus five equally weighted shape MSE terms masked only for exact-zero groups
optimization.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step for every seed

d2_reference.arm: unchanged open-loop interval-38 summary over ten D2 seeds

reporting: all seed metrics, medians, continuous errors, exact-zero confusion counts, per-episode monitor decisions and D2 comparison

decision.pass: freeze D9b state-space formulation and preregister a separate DEV evaluation
decision.fail: keep DEV and TEST closed; diagnose generalization and data coverage without tuning on these held-out outcomes
